IS_TEST().notice: Marker used by Forge to identify test contracts.

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).

test_CircuitBreaker_BoundaryExactly10Pct.notice: H4/O1: a price move of exactly 10% does NOT trigger (strict >).         A move of ~10.1% does trigger. This pins the boundary.

test_CircuitBreaker_FirstCommitNeverTrig.notice: H4/O1: the first price-commit (lastCommitPrice == 0) MUST NOT         trigger the breaker even if the price is wild — there is no         prior price to compare against.

test_CircuitBreaker_TriggersOnGoldPlus50.notice: H4/O1: a >10% MTQ-price jump in a single advanceIndex commit         MUST auto-pause the contract and emit CircuitBreakerTriggered.         Gold +50% → index grows by 0.26 * 0.50 = 13% → triggers.

test_DailyRedeemCap_ResetsAfter24h().notice: T7: the 24h window resets on the first redeem after         dailyRedeemResetAt + 1 days. After reset, dailyRedeemedUsd = 0         and a previously-blocked redeem now succeeds.

test_DailyRedeemCap_RevertWhenCumulative.notice: T7: cumulative daily redeemed gross-USD > dailyRedeemCap         ($500K default) MUST revert with Err95_DailyRedeemCapExceeded.

test_PerTxCap_MintPassesAtExact500K().notice: M2: executeMint with amountUsd == MAX_MINT_PER_TX ($500K exactly)         MUST succeed (boundary: the check is strict >).

test_PerTxCap_MintRevertsAbove500K().notice: M2: executeMint with amountUsd > MAX_MINT_PER_TX ($500K) MUST         revert with Err94_PerTxCapExceeded. The workflow still advances         to BM-15 (the cap is enforced at executeMint, not requestMint).

test_PerTxCap_RedeemRevertsAbove500K().notice: M2: redeem with grossUsd18 > MAX_REDEEM_PER_TX ($500K) MUST         revert with Err94_PerTxCapExceeded.

test_SetDailyRedeemCap_RevertsForNonCoun.notice: T7: setDailyRedeemCap from a non-council address MUST revert         with Err35 (onlyConstitutionalCouncil).

test_SetDailyRedeemCap_RevertsOnZero().notice: T7: setDailyRedeemCap(0) MUST revert (cap must be > 0).

test_SetDailyRedeemCap_SucceedsForCounci.notice: T7: the Constitutional Council can adjust dailyRedeemCap.

test_Slippage_PassAtExactBoundary().notice: H5: executeMint with minMinted == actual minted MUST succeed         (boundary: exactly at the floor).

test_Slippage_PassWithZeroMinMinted().notice: H5: executeMint with minMinted = 0 (no protection) MUST succeed.

test_Slippage_RevertWhenMintedBelowMinMi.notice: H5: executeMint with minMinted > actual minted MUST revert         with Err93_SlippageExceeded.
